map.Macaulay D = Σ t·PVt / P（期）→ 年 = D / f；修: Macaulay D = Σ t·PVt / P (per period) → per year = D / f; modified duration D* = Macaulay / (1+y/f)
map.Macaulay 久期 = 各期现金流现值乘以其时间 t 之和除以债券价格；修正: Macaulay duration = the sum of each period cash flow present value times its time t, divided by the bond price; modified duration = Macaulay divided by (1 + yield per period), giving the percentage price change for a 1% change in yield.
